title: Former Mother-in-Law Describes Lindsay Clancy’s Mental Health Struggle in Murder Trial
summary: Ms. Clancy, who is on trial for murder in the deaths of her three children, tried to find treatment for her deteriorating condition, her ex-husband’s mother testified.
